text: Hi, good evening. Do you have any openings this week for a dental cleaning?
Hi! I'm Kain, the clinic's assistant. Yes, we have openings: Thursday at 10:00 AM or Friday at 5:30 PM. Which works for you?
Friday. By the way, my gums bleed a little when I brush, is that normal?
The doctor needs to check that at your appointment; I can't give you a diagnosis. If you'd like, I'll leave her a note so she can go over it with you.
All set, Laura: dental cleaning on Friday at 5:30 PM, with a note for the doctor. I'll send you a reminder the day before.
My pleasure. Have a good night.
